integrity: Finite exact-arithmetic checks and the analytic proof support the theorem; no external independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The explicit total-variation error is not sharp and tends to zero only when N=o(n^(2/3)); the no-saturation threshold, but not the whole deficit law, extends beyond this range. The finite checker is not an infinite proof. General birthday theory is an acknowledged major antecedent, and independent priority validation remains unperformed.
title: A birthday-scale Poisson law and exact saturation count for cyclic multinomial roughness
